reason: I do free stuff: library storytime, parks, church group. I'd take the free first visit out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay $14 a kid on a normal week when the library costs nothing.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $14 a child plus a sibling at $7 adds up fast when I already have free options, and I'd only pay for a rainy-week emergency.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower drop-in price (around $8 for the first child) or a free or cheap open-play hour, so it's not a $20+ outing for two kids.
